fichas.title: Retail Outlet Entrances
fichas.summary: Guidance describes entrance door widths and clear opening height for retail outlets of different sales areas, alongside illustrated entrance configurations and door types.
uses: Provide access to retail sales outlets
Accommodate accessible entry to larger outlets

dimensions.label: Door width for outlets under 2000 m²
dimensions.context: The text states that door widths can be greater than this for sales outlets under 2000 m².
dimensions.ocr_raw: <2000 m2 the door widths can be >1.00 m

dimensions.label: Clear opening width for outlets over 2000 m²
dimensions.context: The text states that the clear opening width must be greater than this; the sliding-door diagram also marks a central opening of ≥ 2.00.
dimensions.ocr_raw: to those >2000 m2 they must be disability-friendly and have automatic doors. According to the retail regulations, the clear opening width must be >2.00 m

dimensions.label: Clear opening height
dimensions.context: Minimum clear opening height stated for regulated retail entrances; also given in the opening/revolving-door figure caption.
dimensions.ocr_raw: clear opening height of 2.20 m; and the clear height >2.20 m

dimensions.label: Side width shown in sliding-door diagram
dimensions.context: Dimension on each side of the ≥ 2.00 central opening in the sliding-door diagram.

fichas.title: Retail Shop Windows
fichas.summary: Shop windows present merchandise and invite customers to purchase. Their design depends on the goods and should complement the entrance layout, form, and size. The page distinguishes display-area windows, which separate merchandise from the sales area, from windows that provide a view into the shop; both have illustrated variants.
uses: Attract customer interest and invite purchases
Separate displayed goods from the sales area
Provide a view into the sales area
furniture_equipment: Stepped shop-window display with glazed screen behind
Mobile shop-window display unit with screen behind
